title: Angel's Share Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: **Angels' Share has gotten a winter GLOW UP! All new furnishings, rugs, kitchen updates and more!** HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private, heated pool + outdoor shower - Indoor/Outdoor Living at it's finest! - 4 bedroom, sleeps 10 comfortably - 2 spacious living areas with large, flat screen TVs - Large kitchen with cypress ceilings + additional kitchenette - Multiple outdoor space to enjoy including wrap around deck - Walk to town of Seaside and Beach within 5 minutes - Parking for 5 - Welcome Tote included - Sandpiper Linen Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($150 fee applies at booking). * Pool heat at $50/day in the winter * Pet fee of $250 Angel’s Share – A Private Oasis in the Heart of 30A Just 2 blocks from both the beach and Seaside, Angel’s Share offers the perfect blend of location, luxury, and privacy. Nestled under magnolia and oak trees on charming Forest Street, this 4-bedroom, 2-bath home features a private heated pool, two spacious living areas, and multiple outdoor spaces designed for relaxing and entertaining. Upstairs, enjoy an open-concept living/dining area with vaulted cypress ceilings, a wrap-around deck with grill, and a fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances. The main floor also includes a Queen bedroom and full bath. Downstairs features a second living room, kitchenette, 3 additional bedrooms; including a fun bunk room and direct access to the screened-in porch and pool. Walk or bike to the beach, Seaside’s shops and restaurants, or enjoy peaceful evenings at home under the stars. Sleeping Arrangements: Level 2 (main floor of the property) - Large, open concept family room with 55" TV and large sectional sofa - Kitchen with granite tops and butcher block island - Dining area seats 10 inside with additional dining on screened porch - Grill on the wrap around deck - QUEEN bedroom - Full Bathroom with shower only Level 1 - Casual second living room with 50" TV with direct access to the pool - KING Bedroom (as of Jan 2026) overlooking pool - QUEEN bunk room with built in seating and storage - Bunk room (TWINS) sleeping 4- perfect for kids or groups with 2 sets of twin bunks - Kitchenette- Equipped with refrigerator, microwave, sink, coffee maker and w/d - Full bath with tub/shower combo The downstairs porch opens to the 24’ x 10’ pool (optional heating fee of $50.00 per day) in the private fenced back yard.
